title: AAPS 3.4.0.0 - Gaps in network coverage when I leave the Wi-Fi network
body:
AAPS 3.4.0.0
Build: 796d36e-2026.01.20
Flavor: fullrelease
NightScout-Version: 15.0.3
NSClientV3
Android 16
Dexcom G7
original Dexcom APP -> Xdrip+ -> AAPS

I have the following settings in NSClientV3:

Connection settings:

- Use cellular connection: off
- Use Wi-Fi connection: on
- When on battery power: on
- While charging: on

When I return from shopping/a walk, the missing CGM data is not uploaded to NS, and the recording gaps are not filled. Previously, this was automatically "filled in" when I reconnected to Wi-Fi. Since AAPS 3.4.0.0, this no longer happens.

The screenshots show that the gaps only occur with NS; neither the AAPS nor the Dexcom app shows any gaps for the period 9:30 - 11:00.

No, I didn't specify the G7 as the blood glucose source in XDrip+, but rather the "Companion App" because I also use the official Dexcom G7 app. This ensures that in case of sensor failure, data is also stored with Clarity, as Dexcom otherwise causes problems when replacing the sensor. I've been using the combination of Dexcom G7 app -> XDrip+ -> AAPS for over 1.5 years, and it works perfectly together. The problem only started after the AAPS update to version 3.4.0.0; it didn't exist before.

Hi,
Unfortunately, I'm not very familiar with Network Server. I'm using a pre-built instance from ns10be.de so I don't have to deal with the maintenance of Network Server itself. Where can I see what you mentioned, or what can I post here so you can see if the problem lies there?

Because I'm now using a new phone (Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra) and it's not enabled in the official Dexcom app, I've switched to the XDrip+ -> AAPS combination. The Dexcom app is uninstalled and the sensor is started via XDrip+. However, the same error occurs: when I leave and reconnect to Wi-Fi, there's no backfill to NS for the missing data.

There is a bug in NS rendering (NS must be restarted to see backfilled data) but AAPSClient recognize everything correctly
Isn't it your case?

> There is a bug in NS rendering (NS must be restarted to see backfilled data) but AAPSClient recognize everything correctly Isn't it your case?

Just the phone change and switching from Dexcom -> XDrip+ -> AAPS to XDrip+ -> AAPS required me to restart AAPS several times (including restarting my phone), and yet I still have the gaps in NS, just like 2 hours ago.

I have now also restarted the NS server, the missing values ​​are now also displayed.

Is the bug on NS's side or AAPS's side? I hope the bug gets fixed soon.

thx [MilosKozak](https://github.com/MilosKozak)
